scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.migrate: cd server && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { Client } = require('pg'); const client = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } }); client.connect().then(() => client.query(fs.readFileSync('./db/schema.sql', 'utf8'))).then(() => { console.log('Migration successful'); process.exit(0); }).catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.start: npm run migrate && cd server && NODE_ENV=production node dist/index.js
